name: What Happens on Camera Doesn't Always Stay on Camera
source:
"What Happens on Camera Doesn't Always Stay on Camera" is a free, fan-made visual novel game dedicated to the pairing between Sakata Gintoki and Hijikata Toushiro from the series Gintama, which is owned by Hideaki Sorachi. 

This story is directly based on the [url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/2315537]fan fiction written by Aero[/url].

[From [url=https://fawningtales.itch.io/ginhiji-whocdasoc]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《What Happens on Camera Doesn't Always Stay on Camera》是一款免费的同人视觉小说，围绕《银魂》中坂田银时与土方十四郎的配对展开。《银魂》的原作者为空知英秋。

本作直接改编自[url=https://archiveofourown.org/works/2315537]Aero创作的同人小说[/url]。

[来源：[url=https://fawningtales.itch.io/ginhiji-whocdasoc]itch.io[/url]]
